description: The chart, labeled Figure 15: Token Ratio (TR), is intended to illustrate the token ratio across various datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with the names of five datasets, although the exact labels are not visible due to the chart being obscured. The vertical axis represents the token ratio, with a label and a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Each dataset is represented by a bar, with the height of the bar corresponding to the token ratio; the bars are colored in a shade of blue. The token ratio values range from approximately 0.45 to 0.65, with the shortest bar having a value around 0.48 and the tallest bar having a value around 0.62. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar.
